spans.s:
लिह् 1. लिह् (a later form of rt. रिह्), cl.
2. P. A. लेढि, लीढे (2nd sing. P. ले-
क्षि, 2nd and 3rd du. लीढस्), Impf. P. अलेट् or
अलेड् (2nd sing. अलेट्, 2nd du. अलीढम्), Impv. P.
लेढु (2nd sing. लीढि), लिलेह, लिलिहे, लेक्ष्यति,
-ते, अलिक्षत्, अलिक्षत or अलीढ, लेढुम्, to
lick; to lick up; to taste, sip, lap, take any food by
licking or lapping: Pass. लिह्यते, Aor. अलेहि, to be
licked, &c.: Caus. लेहयति, -यितुम्, Aor. अलीलिहत्,
to cause to lick: Desid. लिलिक्षति, -ते: Intens.
लेलिह्यते, लेलेढि, to lick frequently, be constantly
licking, play with the tongue, dart out the tongue;
[cf. Gr. λείχ-ω, λιχ-μά-ω, λιχ-μά-ζ-ω, λιχ-ανό-ς,
λίχ-νο-ς; Lat. li-n-g-o, lig-uri-o, pol-lex; Goth.
bi-laigô-n; Old Germ. lecchôn; Angl. Sax. liccian;
Slav. liz-a-ti; Lith. lez-iu, liz-u-s; Hib. lighim,
im-lighim, ‘I lick.’]
2. लिह्, ट्, ट्, ट्, licking, licking up, tasting.
लिहत्, अन्, अती, अत्, licking, licking up, tasting.
लिह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being licked.
